name: link_fault
description: The SPI link between U1 and U2 is cut, corrupted and restored while input is flowing. U2 must release everything it is holding within 100 ms of losing the link, and a damaged frame must produce no HID report at all - a wrong keystroke on someone's computer is worse than a missing one.
requires: U1 and U2 with the SPI1 link on a header that can be interrupted
A way to corrupt one frame in flight, such as grounding MOSI for one transfer

steps.note: handshake completes and input flows again
a bad CRC must produce nothing, not a guess
U2 keeps serving PC2 while U1 restarts
U1 keeps serving PC1 while U2 restarts

checks.u2_released_within_budget: U2 released every held key within 100 ms of the cut
checks.no_report_from_damaged_frame: no HID report followed any corrupted frame
checks.link_recovered: input flowed again after the link was restored
checks.resets_are_independent: neither reset took the other board down
